info.title: skmtc stack server
info.description: The public API of a deployed @skmtc/server bundle: generate code from an OpenAPI/GraphQL schema against the bundled generator stack, plus schema, capability and enrichment introspection. Codegen is a pure function of (bundle, schema, client settings).

get.description: Content-negotiated on `Accept`: a browser (`text/html`) gets the HTML page, anything else the flat markdown contract — the same text `/index.md` and `/llms.txt` serve.

get.summary: The self-description at the llms.txt convention path
get.description: The same markdown as `/index.md`, at the path agents look for.

post.summary: Generate code artifacts from a schema
post.description: Parse → transform → render the schema through the bundled generators, returning the generated files, the run manifest, and the attribution sidecars + generation map. The schema arrives inline (`schema`) or by URL (`source` — fetched by the server, echoed back with its resolved URL and content digest); `protocol` is inferred from the document when omitted.

artifacts.description: Generated file contents keyed by output path.

sidecars.description: Per-file attribution sidecars keyed by output path.

400.description: Malformed request — invalid JSON body or failed validation.

422.description: Unprocessable — the `source` could not be fetched, or the document could not be read as a schema.

post.description: Parse + each generator’s `isSupported` only — no transform, no render.

subjects.description: Supported subjects keyed by generator id.

post.summary: Seed enrichment values derived from a schema
post.description: The default enrichment values each generator derives from the schema (the "Generate fields from schema" payload) — Parse + `toEnrichmentDefaults` over supported subjects, no transform, no render.

enrichmentDefaults.description: Seed enrichment values, mirroring the `client.json#settings.enrichments` subtree (subject scope): `[generatorId][path][method][variant]` for operations, `[generatorId][refName][variant]` for models.

post.summary: Validate an enrichment config against the stack
post.description: The authoritative verdict on whether the posted `clientSettings.enrichments` satisfy each generator’s enrichment schema. Documentless — no schema needed.

200.description: Validation issues (empty when the config is valid).

post.summary: Normalize a schema document to OpenAPI 3.0
post.description: Convert a Swagger 2.0 document to OpenAPI 3.0; 3.0 / 3.1 documents pass through unchanged. The same normalization the `oas` generate path runs.

schema.description: The input document normalized to an OpenAPI 3.0 document.

400.description: Malformed request — invalid JSON body or failed validation.

422.description: Unprocessable — the `source` could not be fetched, or the document could not be read as a schema.

get.description: The server's own OpenAPI 3.1 document — the one you are reading. Served as a committed static artifact, so it is a pure function of the package version.

protocol.description: Schema protocol. Optional — inferred from the document content when omitted (a JSON/YAML document with an `openapi` or `swagger` key is `oas`; anything else is treated as GraphQL SDL).

schema.description: The schema document itself, as a string.

source.description: URL of the schema document. The server fetches it (following redirects, checking each hop) and echoes the final URL + content digest in the response. Must be publicly reachable: a URL naming a loopback, private, link-local or `.internal` host is refused.

URL of the schema document. The server fetches it (following redirects, checking each hop) and echoes the final URL + content digest in the response. Must be publicly reachable: a URL naming a loopback, private, link-local or `.internal` host is refused.

location.description: Document pointer / path of the issue.

subjectType.description: Subject kind the generator enriches, e.g. `model` or `operation`.

fields.description: Renderable field descriptors (key, type, and field-kind specifics).

subject.description: Operation path or model ref the issue is scoped to.

ResolvedSource.description: Present when the request used `source`: the URL as requested, the final URL after redirects (keep this one — when the source redirects to a content-addressed form it pins the exact document), and a `sha256:<hex>` digest of the fetched bytes.

path.description: Dot path of the offending field. Absent when the issue is a whole-body rule rather than one field — `schema`/`source` exactly-one, for instance.
